instructions.purpose: Check combined calendar conflicts or find slots of a requested duration.

tool.name: find-calendar-availability
tool.description: Merges busy intervals from all configured calendars and reports per-source failures.

usage_rules.rule: Use BellaClaw's configured timezone and explicit RFC 3339 window bounds.
For a slot search, provide durationMinutes and clarify the window when it cannot be safely inferred.
Do not invent working hours. A whole-day check reports calendar conflicts, not that every minute is usable.
Disclose source failures instead of claiming complete availability.
